title: Retrato de Té Matcha Japonés con Superposición de Doodle de Dibujos Animados Kawaii Dibujados a Mano
prompt: A cozy indoor portrait of a person sitting at a traditional Japanese chabudai (low table) holding a cup of matcha green tea and resting face on hand. The scene is enhanced with playful hand-drawn cartoon doodles: a cute orange cartoon maneki-neko (beckoning cat) jumping excitedly beside illustrated cat ears on head, whimsical white sketch lines bubbles sparkles, and motion accents. A smiling cartoon matcha bowl with foam and small dessert plate with dorayaki and mochi illustrated in kawaii style in foreground. Warm natural daylight filtering through shoji screens, tatami mat floor visible. Art style: Portrait photography with hand-drawn cartoon doodles overlay, Kawaii aesthetic, warm tones with green tea and white accents, Japanese cultural elements.
